alias:: Terminal Multiplexer
tags:: [[Tools]]

- # tmux
	- A terminal multiplexer. See [[Tools/Editor]] for the editor it hosts.
	- ## Keys
	  id:: 6a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
		- `C-b d` detaches the session.
		- `C-b [` enters copy mode.
	- ~~~sh
	  tmux new -s work
	  ~~~
